# ElementCollection

## Summary

A collection of elements that may declare profile conformance.

## Description

ElementCollection is defined for the Lite fixture model.

## Metadata

- name: ElementCollection
- subClassOf: Element

## Properties

- element:
  - minCount: 0
- profileConformance:
  - minCount: 0
